narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On April 30, 2024, at approximately 1340 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a landscaping company yard in Novi, Michigan, during a worksite inquiry. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he has never been inspected or admitted at any port of entry. He waded across the Rio Grande near Brownsville, Texas, in August 2017 and has lived in Houston and Michigan since then.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is removable under Section 237(a)(1)(B) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that after admission as a nonimmigrant he remained in the United States for a time longer than permitted.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear.
